observation_indicators.observable_fil: Natutukoy ang limang hazard group at halimbawa; sa isang ulat, may panganib, pinsala, ligtas na tiyak na kontrol, contact o paraan ng pagkumpirma at follow-up.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Names five hazard groups and examples; reports one hazard with harm, specific safe control, contact or verification route, and follow-up.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi makita ang hazard, mag-ingat lang, inimbentong contact/pagwawasto o unsafe action.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Misses the hazard, gives only be careful, invents a contact/correction or proposes unsafe action.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Natutukoy ang limang hazard group at halimbawa; sa isang ulat, may panganib, pinsala, ligtas na tiyak na kontrol, contact o paraan ng pagkumpirma at follow-up. Nagagawa nang walang prompt.
levels.kaya_na_en: Names five hazard groups and examples; reports one hazard with harm, specific safe control, contact or verification route, and follow-up. Completes independently.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May hazard ngunit kulang ang grupo, aksyon, contact o follow-up; punan ang kulang at ulitin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Names a hazard but omits a group, action, contact or follow-up; complete the missing field and retry.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi makita ang hazard, mag-ingat lang, inimbentong contact/pagwawasto o unsafe action.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Misses the hazard, gives only be careful, invents a contact/correction or proposes unsafe action.
